description: Strix Halo (gfx1151) hardware benchmark matrix. Prompt-processing points are llama-bench in-process batched prompt-processing tests and are NOT concurrency. Concurrency points are actual parallel HTTP requests against one llama-server instance; batch-size flags (-b, -ub) are never reported as concurrency.

prompt_processing.interpretation: tok/s is batched prompt-processing throughput for one context; label plainly, never as C1..C8 concurrency

concurrency.method: N concurrent HTTP completion requests in flight against a single llama-server; aggregate tok/s from server-reported predicted token counts over the wall time of the concurrent wave

hip.control_note: HIP_LAUNCH_BLOCKING=1 is a correctness control for a known gfx1151 HIP async-execution bug (strix-llama.cpp README and CI); record benchmarks with the control on. It is a control, not a performance claim.

vulkan.GGML_VK_PERF_LOGGER: optional; per-op timings for profiling runs only, never mixed into reported benchmark numbers

llama_bench.note: -b/-ub are batch-size knobs of the in-process test and are recorded as such, never as concurrency
